themes.twistDescription: Letter-spacing injection adds 0.06em tracking to all heading CSS vars, amplifying the cold industrial uppercase display character of the aerospace brand. D-DIN-Bold replaced with Bricolage Grotesque; D-DIN replaced with Archivo Narrow.

All transition and animation durations scaled up by ×1.5 (fast: 0.3s, standard: 0.45s, slow: 0.75s), making the system's motion vocabulary more deliberate and weighted without altering its single universal easing curve.
All gap, columnGap, and rowGap values scaled up by ×1.4 to open the layout and give each section more editorial breathing room.
All numeric spacing values (padding, margin, gap) scaled up by ×1.35, amplifying the system's already generous spatial rhythm into a more expansive, editorial breathing room.
All hover transition durations slowed by +0.15s (from 0.1s to 0.25s), making every state change feel more deliberate and weighted.
Replaced nav link letter-spacing from 0.05rem to 0.08em, broadening typographic tracking to give the architectural mega-menu links a more pronounced spatial cadence.
The Hero Section paragraph shifted from atmospheric-evocative to kinetic-material — reframing the color field and typographic placement as acts of physical force and load-bearing pressure.
